summary: Closed DEF-p4-char-concept-202 by realigning bible/creatures/creature.json CRE-005 (Gryphon) and CRE-006 (Mock Turtle) to the CHAR-gryphon / CHAR-mock-turtle appearance cards, since the H2-locked sheets were drawn from those cards. bible/characters/** was not touched (memory-bible owns it). Recorded as bible/changelog.md BIB-0031. No images generated or re-rolled (budget 0).

defects_opened.summary: Found while picking the next free BIB number: creature.json's own _meta.amendments[] uses change_id BIB-0029 for the p4-h2-creature amendment, and bible/changelog.md separately uses BIB-0029 for the unrelated p4-h2-bible amendment (characters/costumes). Two different changes sharing one id, likely a parallel-write collision. Not fixed here (not in scope, doesn't affect this task's content); assigned to memory-bible.

arbitration_applied: H2-locked sheet is the reference: creature.json realigned to the appearance cards for every field visible on the sheet (colour, hide-vs-scale, eye colour). For measurements not verifiable from a plain-backdrop sheet, adopted the appearance-card figures rather than creature.json's own designed ones, because 03-characters/appearance's numbers are what the character-consistency check reads and the whitebox/staging chain needs one number per creature. No field was found where the appearance-card number looked wrong instead; nothing routed back for a bible/characters/** change.

CRE-005_gryphon.head_sitting_height_cm: ~150-165 (new field, not previously carried in creature.json)
CRE-005_gryphon.surface_unchanged: golden-brown feather-to-tawny-fur blend — not flagged by the defect, left as-is (roughly consistent with the appearance card's feather/fur description, no direct contradiction)

CRE-006_mock_turtle.front_flippers: grey-olive SCALED turtle skin (was dun-brown calf hide)
CRE-006_mock_turtle.neck: grey-olive scaled turtle skin blending into calf hide only at the head (was calf hide from the neck up)
CRE-006_mock_turtle.carapace_colour: olive-brown with faded amber-and-dark hexagonal scutes + a few barnacles (was 'weathered ridged brown-green')
CRE-006_mock_turtle.head: brown-and-white patched, white blaze, floppy ears added (was unspecified colour, 'small rounded' ears)

rendering_spec_layer_unchanged: photoreal CGI, feather-to-fur / turtle-skin-to-calf-hide blend, no costume, no cartoon styling — confirmed correct by the work order, not touched.
